title: Sign up, sign in, session recovery, and sign out
accessibility: Form fields have persistent labels and programmatic error relationships
Focus order and visible focus remain coherent through validation and redirects
Keyboard-only sign-in and sign-out complete without traps
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Protected routes reject anonymous and expired sessions
next redirects remain same-origin and allowlisted
Sign-out invalidates server and browser session authority
Rate limiting does not reveal whether an account exists
persistence: A valid session survives a reload within policy
Sign-out remains effective after reload and back navigation
concurrency: Concurrent login attempts do not create conflicting session state
Sign-out in one tab revokes protected access in another tab
degradedDependencies: Auth provider timeout fails closed with a recoverable error
Database outage does not render protected cached data
Email provider outage preserves a retryable confirmation state
rollback: Previous auth release can read current session cookies or explicitly invalidates them
Rollback does not bypass newly required policy
